description: Returns information about a transaction given a block number and transaction index position.

parameters.name: blockNumber
parameters.description: The block number as a string in hexadecimal format or tags. The supported tag values include earliest for the earliest/genesis block, latest for the latest mined block, pending for the pending state/transactions, safe for the most recent secure block, and finalized for the most recent secure block accepted by more than 2/3 of validators. safe and finalized are only supported on Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Arbitrum Nova, and Avalanche C-chain

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: An integer of the transaction index position encoded as a hexadecimal

object.description: The transaction response object, or null if no transaction is found:

object.blockHash.description: The hash of the block where this log was in. null when it's a pending log

object.blockNumber.description: The block number where this log was in. null when it's a pending log

object.gas.description: The gas provided by the sender, encoded as hexadecimal

object.gasPrice.description: The gas price provided by the sender in wei, encoded as hexadecimal

object.maxFeePerGas.description: The maximum fee per gas set in the transaction

object.maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: The maximum priority gas fee set in the transaction

object.input.description: The data sent along with the transaction

object.nonce.description: The number of transactions made by the sender prior to this one encoded as hexadecimal

object.to.description: The address of the receiver. null when it's a contract creation transaction

object.transactionIndex.description: The integer of the transaction's index position that the log was created from. null when it's a pending log

object.value.description: The value transferred in wei encoded as hexadecimal

object.chainId.description: The chain id of the transaction, if any

object.v.description: The standardized V field of the signature

object.r.description: The R field of the signature

object.s.description: The S field of the signature
